name: lms-benchmarks
description: K6 Performance Testing Suite for LuminaLMS

scripts.test:public: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/api/v1 -e VUS=600 -e DURATION=30s scenarios/public_load_test.js
scripts.test:auth: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/api/v1 -e VUS=5 -e DURATION=30s scenarios/auth_load_test.js
scripts.test:student: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/api/v1 -e VUS=50 -e DURATION=30s scenarios/student_load_test.js
scripts.test:instructor: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/api/v1 -e VUS=50 -e DURATION=30s scenarios/instructor_load_test.js
scripts.test:admin: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/api/v1 -e VUS=5 -e DURATION=30s scenarios/admin_load_test.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test:public && npm run test:auth && npm run test:student && npm run test:instructor && npm run test:admin
